The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/engwmbb/copyright.htm):
> The World Messianic Bible is not copyrighted, however "World Messianic Bible" is a Trademark.

> any more. This is to avoid confusion, not to limit your freedom. The Holy Bible is God's Word. It belongs to God. He gave it to us freely, and we who have worked on this translation freely give it to you by dedicating it

> This edition uses British/International spelling.
> August 2022 stable text

Why this is public domain:
Text: the World Messianic Bible, British edition, August 2022 stable text, derived from the World English Bible; no Apocrypha. Editor and main translator: Michael Paul Johnson (living, United States), who is also the owner of eBible.org (WEB FAQ: "The senior editor and main translator is Michael Paul Johnson"; eBible.org's legal page names eBible.org a registered business name running mljohnson.org and WorldEnglish.Bible). The other contributors are not listed (WEB FAQ: "We don't publish a complete list"); the project's dedication covers them. Base text: the American Standard Version, first published in 1901 in the United States, public domain there since it was published before 1931. The maintainer's rule (2026-10-16): a translation project's own public-domain dedication, in the project's own words and contradicted by nothing from the same holder, counts as the authors' own. The statement asks that a changed text not be called by the translation's name, "a condition of our trademark use" (WEB FAQ). The maintainer's decision (2026-10-16): this restricts only the name, not copying or changing the text, so it does not contradict the dedication.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engwmbb), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/engwmbb/copyright.htm), https://ebible.org/eng-web/webfaq.htm; https://ebible.org/legal.php; https://mljohnson.org/; https://worldenglish.bible/; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.
